units.source_text: 到了三月下旬，紫姬所居春殿的庭院中，春景比往年更为浓艳，花色鲜明，鸟声清脆，

en.t: By late March, in the garden of the spring palace where Lady Murasaki lived, the spring scenery was richer and more radiant than in other years, the flowers were vivid, and the birdsong was clear.

units.source_text: 在别处的人看来，只有此地还是盛春，觉得有些不可思议。

en.t: To people from elsewhere, it seemed almost mysterious that only this place was still in the full height of spring.

units.source_text: 小山上树色葱茏，浮岛上苔色浓绿，许多青年女子仅乎远眺此景，觉得不够味儿。

en.t: The trees on the little hill were lush and green, and the moss on the floating island was deep in color; many young ladies felt that merely gazing at the scene from afar was not satisfying enough.

units.source_text: 源氏便命将预先造好的中国式游船赶快装饰。

en.t: Genji therefore ordered that the Chinese-style pleasure boats prepared in advance be quickly decorated.

units.source_text: 初次下水的一天，从雅乐寮宣召些乐人来，叫他们在船中奏乐。

en.t: On the day the boats were first launched, he summoned musicians from the Bureau of Court Music and had them perform aboard the boats.

units.source_text: 当天诸亲王及公卿都来参与。

en.t: That day, the princes and court nobles all came to take part.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后此时也正乞假归里。

en.t: At this time, Empress Akikonomu had also taken leave and returned to her family residence.

units.source_text: 去年秋天，秋好皇后讥讽紫姬的诗中有“盼待春光到小园”之句，

en.t: Last autumn, in a poem teasing Lady Murasaki, Empress Akikonomu had included the line about waiting for spring light to reach a small garden.

units.source_text: 紫姬觉得现在正是报复的时候了。

en.t: Lady Murasaki felt that now was exactly the time to answer her back.

units.source_text: 源氏也想劝请秋好皇后来此看花，然而没有机会。

en.t: Genji also wanted to invite Empress Akikonomu here to view the flowers, but there was no opportunity.

units.source_text: 况且皇后身份高贵，不便轻易出来赏花。

en.t: Moreover, because the empress held such exalted rank, it was not convenient for her to go out casually to enjoy the blossoms.

units.source_text: 他就叫秋殿中爱好此种情趣的青年侍女都来乘船。

en.t: So he had the young gentlewomen in the autumn palace who appreciated such refinements come and ride in the boats.

units.source_text: 皇后院中的南湖与这里的湖水相通，其间隔着一座小山，好比一个关口。

en.t: The southern lake in the empress's residence was connected with the water here, with a small hill lying between them like a barrier gate.

units.source_text: 但可从山脚上绕道通船。

en.t: But boats could pass by making a detour around the foot of the hill.

units.source_text: 紫姬身边的青年侍女都集中在这里东边的钓殿里。

en.t: The young gentlewomen attending Lady Murasaki all gathered in the fishing pavilion on the eastern side here.
